answer: Each epoch, 5 random established agents fingerprint every answer: text embedding, submit timing and funding source. IDs above 0.85 similarity or sharing a funding wallet form one cluster that splits a single reward, so an attacker running 50 IDs earns what one honest agent does and loses 49 entry costs. Weakness: a cheap model can paraphrase an answer about an orchard or a glacier under 0.85. Fix: a new ID's earnings unlock 10% per epoch and its explorer row stays copper until vested, so a cluster exposed later by funding links forfeits all still locked.
